# ContractorAITools
> AI & software tools for contractors. Free curated directory of 66 listings. Links checked 2026-10-19.

## Estimating & Takeoff
- [STACK](https://www.stackct.com): Cloud takeoff and estimating
- [PlanSwift](https://www.planswift.com): Desktop digital takeoff
- [Togal.AI](https://www.togal.ai): AI-automated takeoffs
- [Kreo](https://www.kreo.net): AI takeoff from drawings
- [Clear Estimates](https://www.clearestimates.com): Remodeler estimates
- [Bluebeam](https://www.bluebeam.com): PDF markup and takeoff
- [Buildxact](https://www.buildxact.com/us/): Builder estimating and quotes
- [Square Takeoff](https://squaretakeoff.com): Online takeoff and estimating
- [Beam AI](https://www.ibeam.ai): AI-assisted quantity takeoff
- [Attentive.ai](https://www.attentive.ai): AI takeoff for landscaping and paving
- [RoofSnap](https://roofsnap.com): Roof measurement and estimates
- [Countfire](https://www.countfire.com): Fire and electrical takeoff
## Bidding & Preconstruction
- [BuildingConnected](https://construction.autodesk.com/products/buildingconnected/): Bid management network
- [ConstructConnect](https://www.constructconnect.com): Project leads and bid tools
- [Downtobid](https://downtobid.com): AI bid invitations for GCs
- [Document Crunch](https://www.documentcrunch.com): AI contract risk review
- [Trunk Tools](https://trunktools.com): AI for construction documents
## Project Management & Scheduling
- [Procore](https://www.procore.com): Construction PM platform
- [Buildertrend](https://buildertrend.com): Residential builder PM
- [JobTread](https://www.jobtread.com): Budgets, schedules, client portal
- [Fieldwire](https://www.fieldwire.com): Field task management
- [Autodesk Build](https://construction.autodesk.com): Autodesk construction cloud
- [Houzz Pro](https://pro.houzz.com/pro): Remodeler PM and leads
- [Contractor Foreman](https://contractorforeman.com/): All-in-one contractor PM
- [Projul](https://projul.com): Construction CRM and scheduling
- [Buildbook](https://buildbook.co): Client-facing builder PM
- [Sitemate](https://sitemate.com): Forms and field workflows
## Field Service, CRM & Invoicing
- [Jobber](https://www.getjobber.com/): Quotes, scheduling, invoicing
- [Housecall Pro](https://www.housecallpro.com): Home-service operations
- [ServiceTitan](https://www.servicetitan.com): Trades enterprise platform
- [Joist](https://www.joist.com): Estimates and invoices app
- [Knowify](https://knowify.com): Contractor job costing
- [JobNimbus](https://www.jobnimbus.com): Roofing CRM
- [AccuLynx](https://acculynx.com): Roofing business software
- [ServiceM8](https://www.servicem8.com): Job management for trades
- [Workiz](https://www.workiz.com): Field service management
- [FieldEdge](https://fieldedge.com): HVAC and plumbing software
- [Kickserv](https://www.kickserv.com): Small field-service CRM
- [Service Fusion](https://www.servicefusion.com): Field service software
- [Roofr](https://roofr.com): Roof reports and proposals
- [Avoca](https://www.avoca.ai): AI call answering for home services
- [Rilla](https://www.rilla.com): Speech analytics for field sales
## Drawings, Photos & Documentation
- [CompanyCam](https://companycam.com): Jobsite photo docs
- [OpenSpace](https://www.openspace.ai): AI 360 site capture
- [DroneDeploy](https://www.dronedeploy.com): Drone site mapping
- [EagleView](https://www.eagleview.com): Aerial roof measurements
- [Hover](https://hover.to): 3D home models from photos
- [Matterport](https://matterport.com): 3D digital twins of spaces
- [magicplan](https://magicplan.app/): Floor plans from a phone
## Safety, Time & Compliance
- [Mitti by SafetyCulture](https://mitti.com/): Inspections, checklists and workplace operations (SafetyCulture's platform)
- [Raken](https://www.rakenapp.com): Daily reports and timecards
- [HammerTech](https://www.hammertech.com/en-us/): Construction safety platform
- [Busybusy](https://busybusy.com): GPS time tracking
- [ClockShark](https://www.clockshark.com): Crew time tracking
- [Workyard](https://www.workyard.com): GPS timesheets and job costing
- [Safesite](https://safesitehq.com): Safety inspections app
## Accounting, Payroll & Payments
- [QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com): Small-business accounting
- [Foundation Software](https://www.foundationsoft.com): Construction accounting
- [Gusto](https://gusto.com): Payroll and HR
- [Siteline](https://www.siteline.com): Pay application billing
- [Built](https://getbuilt.com): Construction lending and payments
